structured_output.what_is_happening: A token called "Shillpad" (8Xm4…) is trading on a PumpSwap pair created at 09:23 UTC. In about 40 minutes it did roughly $1M of volume and went up about 4x to a peak near $400k+ mcap. By 10:0x UTC it had fallen back to about $210k (DexScreener pair API). It is named after shillpad.fun, a new Solana launchpad that sends creator fees to a locked "Pot" and pays the X accounts that shill a coin hardest every 6 hours. However, the Shillpad website's only contract address is 6Cw4kWUaZHmh71E3YRiHFRvLA28EiYp4Px2GkUrXfvWM, not this token. That other token had about $713k of 24h volume and has since crashed about 73% to a $12.7k mcap. At least 10 other same-name tokens were launched between 08:25 and 09:23 UTC, which points to a same-name launch frenzy.

narrative.description: A new 'get paid to shill' launchpad (shillpad.fun) that pays X Money to the accounts that push a ticker hardest. The concept is novel and self-promoting on crypto Twitter. Several similar sites exist (shillpumpfun.com, coinshill.fun, shillrz.fun, shillz.app).
narrative.why_spreading: The launchpad itself rewards shilling, and traders are rotating through many same-name tokens in search of 'the real' platform coin. I found no organic news, Reddit or Telegram coverage.

token_connection.why_this_token: GeckoTerminal/GMGN link this token's socials to a @Shillpaddotfun status post and to shillpad.fun. Anyone can set those metadata links on a Meteora launch. The official website shows a different CA (6Cw4…). I could not read the linked X status (HTTP 402), so I could not check whether the project endorsed 8Xm4.
token_connection.competing_tokens: 6Cw4kWU… is the CA on the official site: PumpSwap, $12.7k mcap, $8.8k liquidity, $713k 24h volume, -73% over 24h. There are also 9+ other dead Shillpad clones created 08:25-09:10 UTC, one showing a stale $7.2M mcap with zero liquidity.

authenticity.evidence: GeckoTerminal shows 2,084 unique buyers against only 86 unique sellers, with 1,531 buyers arriving within a single 15-30 minute window. That pattern fits bot/bundled buying or a wallet spray more than organic retail. GMGN flags 28 bundler wallets and 8 snipers. There is no DexScreener profile and there are no boosts. It trades beside a dozen same-name clones launched within the same hour.
authenticity.uncertainty: I had no X data. The linked Shillpad X status could not be fetched, so I can't rule out that the project endorsed this CA.

structural_risks: A single non-pool-labeled address (FhVo…) holds 80.05% of supply according to RugCheck. It may be the Meteora DBC vault, which has a near-zero price quote; either way it is a large supply overhang or arbitrage risk.
RugCheck flags 'Large Amount of LP Unlocked' as danger, with 0% locked on one of the top markets.
Liquidity is about $37-42k against roughly $1M of hourly volume. Turnover of about 25x points to churn, which reverses fast.
Mcap already fell from about $287k to about $210k during the research window. It needs about $420k+ from entry to double.
The creator's token status is 'creator_close', and this is their second launch.

structured_output.counterargument: If the Shillpad team moved its official coin to 8Xm4 (GeckoTerminal links it to a specific @Shillpaddotfun status post, and the website CA may be stale), then this is the canonical platform token of a new, viral-by-design launchpad. It has 2,000+ holders and $1M of volume in its first hour. A reclaim of the ~$420k high and a push to a 2x from about $210k is plausible within 6 hours.
unknowns: What the linked X status says, and whether it names 8Xm4 as official
Who controls the FhVo… address holding 80%
Whether the website CA (6Cw4) is current or stale

source_coverage.notes: The site shillpad.fun lists CA 6Cw4…, not this token. The /docs page returns 404. The X status fetch returned 402. A CA search found nothing indexed.

structured_output.thesis: This is most likely a non-canonical or hijacked 'Shillpad' coin: the official site lists a different CA. It shows bot-like buyer patterns, an 80% single-holder overhang and unlocked LP, and it is already about 25% off the level at detection. Doubling from entry is unlikely.
